_metadata.description: Enterprise wireless AP catalog. Watts are typical full-load draw used to estimate PoE utilization on switches. dual_home_capable indicates the AP supports redundant uplinks to two switches with PoE failover (dual mGig, LAG/LACP, or smart-rate paired ports). Vendor field is used by the Configure-APs dialog to filter AP models to match the closet's switch vendor (single-vendor closets are the norm).
_metadata.pricing_note: list_price_usd is a street price (CDW advertised or sign-in price from a cdw.com web snapshot, see price_source) unless price_source says otherwise; msrp_usd is the manufacturer list price CDW showed alongside it. Prices are planning figures, not quotes.
